stock.description: LC Group Holding Ltd. engages in the provision of cross-border logistics solutions. It operates through the Cross-Border Logistics Services and Others segments. The Cross-Border Logistics Services segment provides integrated logistics services to its customers throughout the entire logistics process to deliver cargo to the destination countries. The company was founded by Xin Xu on November 16, 2004 and is headquartered in Qingdao, China.
